text_blocks.snippet: To get a Citizens One mortgage payoff, you'll need to obtain a current payoff quote. You can find this by logging into your Citizens Online Banking account, where it will be listed under "Current Balance" or "Loan Details", or by contacting their customer service department at 833.531. 1312. You can also request a payoff quote for a specific date by going to Payments > Payoff Loan within the online portal.
Steps to Obtain a Payoff Quote:

list.snippet: Access your online account: Log in to your Citizens Online Banking account.
Locate the payoff information: Find your payoff amount under "Current Balance" or "Loan Details".
Request a specific date payoff (if needed): Navigate to Payments > Payoff Loan and follow the prompts.
Contact customer service: If you need further assistance or prefer to speak with someone directly, call 833.531. 1312.
